name: edits-by-instagram
title: Edits
description: Browse, open, duplicate, and organize Instagram Edits projects from Raycast. Requires Edits for Mac installed, signed in, and running with automation enabled.
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: search-projects
commands.title: Search Projects
commands.description: Search Edits projects and open, duplicate, rename, favorite, or pin them.

commands.name: connect-to-edits
commands.title: Connect to Edits
commands.description: Set up the local automation connection and check its status.

commands.name: connection-status
commands.title: Connection Status
commands.description: Check the local Edits MCP server and available project workflows.

commands.name: discover-capabilities
commands.title: Discover Capabilities
commands.description: Inspect tools, schemas, and resource metadata exposed by Edits.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: endpoint
preferences.title: MCP Endpoint
preferences.description: Copy the complete local endpoint from Edits → Settings → Automation. No default endpoint is assumed.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Automation Token
preferences.description: Copy the access token from Edits → Settings → Automation. Never enter Instagram credentials.

tools.name: list-projects
tools.title: List Projects
tools.description: Find Edits projects by name and retrieve exact IDs, status, and available operations.

tools.name: check-connection
tools.title: Check Connection
tools.description: Check the local Edits connection and availability of verified project operations.

tools.name: open-project
tools.title: Open Project
tools.description: Open an Edits project by its exact ID from list-projects.

tools.name: duplicate-project
tools.title: Duplicate Project
tools.description: Create a copy of an existing Edits project from its exact ID. Requires the home screen. Never automatically retry.

tools.name: rename-project
tools.title: Rename Project
tools.description: Rename an existing Edits project using its exact ID and the requested new name.

tools.name: set-project-favorite
tools.title: Set Project Favorite
tools.description: Set a project’s favorite status to true or false; repeated requests leave the desired state unchanged.

tools.name: set-project-pinned
tools.title: Set Project Pinned
tools.description: Set a project’s pinned status to true or false; repeated requests leave the desired state unchanged.

tools.name: list-project-text
tools.title: List Project Text
tools.description: Open an exact project and inspect its text overlays, IDs, and timing before editing.

tools.name: edit-project-text
tools.title: Edit Project Text
tools.description: Replace a text overlay with an exact original-text check, save, and reopen to verify persistence. Requires confirmation. Never automatically retry.
